skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.wholeUnchangedAcquisitionScopeDe: Die lernende Person kann anhand bereitgestellter Beispiele die Auswirkungen der Entwicklung von Medikamenten in historischen und aktuellen gesellschaftlichen Zusammenhängen anhand belegter Wirkung, Versorgung und Zugang, Kosten, Sicherheit sowie Resistenz- und Evidenzgrenzen begründet bewerten und ihr Urteil bei geänderten Wirksamkeitsannahmen revidieren.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.wholeUnchangedAcquisitionScopeEn: Using supplied examples, the learner can give a reasoned evaluation of the effects of medicine development in historical and current social contexts using evidenced effectiveness, supply and access, costs, safety, resistance and evidence limits, and revise the judgment when assumptions about effectiveness change.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.scopeDecisionBasis: The supervising Root explicitly confirmed that both external independent reviewers accepted the finite retention plan. This technical successor binds the same already authored duty to the same existing course/stage/view coordinates and adds no scientific judgment.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.compilerInputBoundary: The unchanged applicability compiler reads only the supported jurisdiction override registry (or extendedData.applicabilityOverrides). These declaration viewIds/courseProfiles/stageIntents document exact approved coordinates; they add no compiler dimensions or runtime selector. Existing explicit composition target roles enforce the narrower coordinates.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.assessmentBoundary: The whole selected description/profile and complete operative materials remain exact. No practical execution, independent actual data, fresh transfer, supervision, safety/local release, model boundary, indicator or quantitative duty is weakened. Provided fictional data is not actual learner execution.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.officialSourceBoundary: This is own SkillPilot acquisition retention and supplies no official whole-source credit or universal official duty. New HB source-bound duties stay partial under their exact source200/232 or P3 source-course boundaries.
skillPilotAcquisitionExtensions.topicChoiceBoundary: All already authored topics remain included under the owner16Oct policy; actual learner theme choice and a persisted selection flow are not claimed.
